    Twisted traces of types A and D (Appendix A, "Types A and D") #

    periodic-mesh-calculations.tex, assuming char k ≠ 2 in the form "m + m = 0 implies m = 0" on the target group:

    • a path rooted at an end (one arm): x_1 = 0 by the centre relation;
    • a path rooted at its middle vertex (two arms of equal length): the two closed paths are x and -x, and reflection sends x to -x;
    • type D with the short arms a, b and long arm c, with trivial twist or with the short-arm interchange;
    • D_4 with a three-cycle of the arms.
    source
    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.TraceAlg.trace_A1 {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M] {L : Fin 1 → ℕ} (D : TraceData L M) {w : List (Fin 1)} (hw : w ≠ []) :
    D.tr w = 0

    One arm: every positive trace vanishes.

    source
    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.TraceAlg.trace_A2 {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M] {L : Fin 2 → ℕ} (D : TraceData L M) (h2 : ∀ (m : M), m + m = 0 → m = 0) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hw : w ≠ []) :
    D.tr w = 0

    Two arms of equal length (path of odd length rooted at its middle): every positive trace vanishes, for the trivial twist and for the reflection.

      theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.TraceAlg.trace_D4_cycle {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] {L : Fin 3 → ℕ} (hL : ∀ (i : Fin 3), L i = 0) (D : TraceData L M) (hcyc : ∀ (i : Fin 3), D.θ i ≠ i) {w : List (Fin 3)} (hw : 2 ≤ w.length) :
      D.tr w = 0

      D_4 with a three-cycle of the arms: the corner is spanned by 1, x, y, xy with yx = -xy and all words of length three zero, and [xy] = 0; so every trace of length at least two vanishes.
